classifications.rationale: The President presently transfers title and improvements to the Territory of Hawaii; the legal consequence occurs through this provision itself.
classifications.evidence: title to the following-described tract of land at Sand Island

classifications.rationale: The provision itself encumbers the transfer with reserved federal easements and imposes a relocation duty on the Territory, with termination tied to future abandonment.
classifications.evidence: A reservation of easements and improvements appurtenant thereto, in favor of the United States of America

classifications.rationale: The President presently reserves portions of the transferred land to the United States until relocation is completed.
classifications.evidence: there are hereby reserved to the United States all such portions of the land hereinabove described

classifications.rationale: The provision itself subjects the transferred land to present and future airport-zoning laws, rules, and regulations.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to all the laws, rules and regulations with respect to airport zoning

classifications.rationale: The provision directly imposes on the Territory a legal duty to provide necessary access rights and utility easements to serve retained federal land.
classifications.evidence: The Territory of Hawaii shall provide such rights of access and utility easements

classifications.rationale: The provision itself legally conditions any sale, lease, or other disposition of the transferred lands on the cited statute.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to the provisions of the act of August 25, 1958

classifications.rationale: The provision itself makes the transferred land subject to the statute's other provisions.
classifications.evidence: The land transferred by this order shall be subject to such other provisions

classifications.rationale: The President presently withdraws the transferred lands from prior executive-order reservations and federal jurisdiction and control.
classifications.evidence: are hereby withdrawn from the application of any such orders or from such jurisdiction and control
